name: lifecycle
command:
python3 ../test/ci_run_commands.py \
  --check 'browser unit tests' 'node --test unit/*.test.js' \
  --check 'software visibility' 'GLOB2_TEST_RENDERER=software xvfb-run -a npx playwright test --config visibility.config.js' \
  --check 'WebGL visibility' 'GLOB2_TEST_RENDERER=webgl2 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test --config visibility.config.js'

name: chromium webgl2 responsive and startup
command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test responsive-presentation.spec.js runtime-build.spec.js --project=chromium

name: webkit
command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test runtime-build.spec.js threading.spec.js viewport.spec.js responsive-presentation.spec.js campaign-editor-storage.spec.js --project=webkit

name: webkit scripting
command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=webkit --grep='shared scripting corpus'

name: firefox
command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test runtime-build.spec.js threading.spec.js viewport.spec.js responsive-presentation.spec.js campaign-editor-storage.spec.js --project=firefox

name: firefox WSS and simulation
command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test multiplayer.spec.js determinism.spec.js --project=firefox --grep='YOG admission enforces|browser and native players|WebAssembly produces|WebAssembly verifies'

name: webkit WSS and simulation
command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test multiplayer.spec.js determinism.spec.js --project=webkit --grep='YOG admission enforces|browser and native players|WebAssembly produces|WebAssembly verifies'

name: firefox scripting
command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=firefox --grep='shared scripting corpus'
